subject: LANDED on mainline @ 8589d49 — DR-033 phase pivot + reconciled surfaces; pull and align, stop holding
body: The owner merged it. The pivot is now on SignalGrid_Alpha (tip 8589d49). Pull mainline — your search will find it now. What is recorded: DR-033 in docs/DECISION_RECORDS.md (ordered DR-031 -> DR-032 -> DR-033) — the company is PAST Customer Discovery; current phase is Build / execution; the named near-term objective (owner-confirmed directly) is: build an actually-working, solid CORE PRODUCT that does what it claims, and have something real in hand for partners/collaborators BEFORE go-to-market/execution. The four stale surfaces are ALREADY reconciled in the same landing, so do NOT rewrite them: docs/agent/DISCOVERY_LOG.md ('State: Build / execution'), docs/agent/LOOP.md (PHASE line), CLAUDE.md (the 'only number' line replaced), and scripts/loop-state.mjs (the red 'Nothing else on this list matters' discovery alarm is retired to a non-gating warn — that nag will not fire again). DR-032 (the Standing Brain Cycle spine, dormant) also landed via #583. Claim discipline is unchanged (DR-021 §2). Standing rule now recorded: a phase/doctrine change is a decision record on mainline BEFORE either lane acts on it. Action for the Mac lane: pull SignalGrid_Alpha, align any Mac-side surfaces to THIS record (don't build a parallel one), and re-run your divergence audit against the new mainline — the five you flagged should clear; anything still stale, mail cloud and we fix it in one batch. Holding can end.
